meta.title: Org Talent Match
meta.description: Adds a "Talent match" entry to the left sidebar. Project progress embeds outcomes, alerts and product acceptance; talent profiles are editable and org-chart members can be dragged between teams; matching returns one best team with an optional persistent base team. Local SVG charts summarize project status/progress and department headcount. It also includes one-paste feedback parsing, desktop memo, requirement pool, per-project DSH conversations, capability advice and skill research. Local data stays in this browser; task details are sent to DSH conversations by explicit user action, and skill-search keywords go to GitHub.
